source_construction.tree_digest_algorithm: Root is fixed_backend/app. Exclude any path containing __pycache__. Sort POSIX paths relative to that app root with Python codepoint ordering (first path: __init__.py). For each file append relative_path, NUL, lowercase SHA-256 hex, newline; UTF-8 encode the concatenation and SHA-256 it.

migration_count_boundary.pre_migration_synthetic_prerequisite: one explicitly marked SYSTEM_ADMIN plus three audited setup records
migration_count_boundary.protected_history_unchanged_meaning: 0014 did not rewrite the pre-existing users, phones, work orders, clocks, identity history or audit rows; it does not mean the approved synthetic prerequisite inserted no new rows.

scope_limits.hardcoded_catalog_ids: The bounded verifier used the restored synthetic tenant/property/house IDs 1/1/1; it does not claim dynamic resource discovery.
scope_limits.concurrency: Two contenders re-entered an already COMPLETED case. This proves idempotent duplicate completion only, not a first-completion race.
